verses.ar: وَٱلطُّورِ
verses.en: By the Mount

verses.ar: وَكِتَٰبࣲ مَّسۡطُورࣲ‏
verses.en: And a Scripture inscribed

verses.ar: فِي رَقࣲّ مَّنشُورࣲ‏
verses.en: On fine parchment unrolled

verses.ar: وَٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡمُورِ
verses.en: And the House frequented

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّقۡفِ ٱلۡمَرۡفُوعِ
verses.en: And the roof exalted

verses.ar: وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ ٱلۡمَسۡجُورِ
verses.en: And the sea kept filled

verses.ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعࣱ‏
verses.en: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass

verses.ar: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعࣲ‏
verses.en: There is none that can ward it off

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرࣰ ا
verses.en: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving

verses.ar: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرࣰ ا
verses.en: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement

verses.ar: فَوَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Then woe that day unto the deniers

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي خَوۡضࣲ يَلۡعَبُونَ
verses.en: Who play in talk of grave matters

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
verses.en: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell

verses.ar: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny

verses.ar: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
verses.en: Is this magic, or do ye not see

verses.ar: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.en: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَنَعِيمࣲ‏
verses.en: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight

verses.ar: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
verses.en: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire

verses.ar: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.en: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do

verses.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرࣲ مَّصۡفُوفَةࣲۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينࣲ‏
verses.en: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءࣲۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينࣱ‏
verses.en: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned

verses.ar: وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةࣲ وَلَحۡمࣲ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
verses.en: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire

verses.ar: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسࣰ ا لَّا لَغۡوࣱ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمࣱ‏
verses.en: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin

verses.ar: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانࣱ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤࣱ مَّكۡنُونࣱ‏
verses.en: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls

verses.ar: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.en: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning

verses.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ
verses.en: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious

verses.ar: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.en: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire

verses.ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful

verses.ar: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنࣲ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
verses.en: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman

verses.ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرࣱ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
verses.en: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time

verses.ar: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verses.en: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant

verses.ar: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ طَاغُونَ
verses.en: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk

verses.ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.en: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe

verses.ar: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثࣲ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful

verses.ar: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
verses.en: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators

verses.ar: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.en: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing

verses.ar: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ
verses.en: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)

verses.ar: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمࣱ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest

verses.ar: أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
verses.en: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons

verses.ar: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمࣲ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
verses.en: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt

verses.ar: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
verses.en: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down

verses.ar: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدࣰ اۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ
verses.en: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared

verses.ar: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
verses.en: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)

verses.ar: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطࣰ ا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابࣱ مَّرۡكُومࣱ‏
verses.en: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds

verses.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
verses.en: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابࣰ ا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.en: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not

verses.ar: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.en: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.en: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars
